name: Kouzuki Yui
source:
A second-year student at Toshinoka Academy.

Yui is a classmate of Yuu and Nozomi. They met in their first year at the Academy and became good friends. She is the mood maker of the group. Always bringing energy to the group, she even manages to play both the boke and tsukkomi at the same time.

She is cheerful and energetic. She is noisy. But somehow, you can't hate her. Before you know it, she's at the center of some commotion or another.

Yui is secretly proud of the fact that her breasts have recently grown a little. However, when she sees that Nozomi's breasts have grown more rapidly than hers after getting a boyfriend, she makes an absurd (but she's serious) complaint, saying, "That is so typical of girls who have boyfriends..."

Yui seems to be very curious about the relationship between Yuu and Nozomi, who are now lovers. When she found an insect bite on Yuu's neck, she mistook it for a love bite and made a fuss. She's friendly with Yuu but is often harsh on him because Nozomi, whom she loves, always pays attention to him... But that might just be the flip side of a secret feeling deep in her heart.

She's always lively and full of energy, but at certain moments, she shows her delicate, girly side. Will the day ever come when she becomes aware of her own feelings?

[Translated from the [url=https://pulltop-latte.jp/PL06/#character]official website[/url]]
